# Nextech Telegram Ecosystem — Full public reference

Creator: Trésor HONTONNOU
Known as: Tresor562
Organization / ecosystem: Nextech (also written Nexus Tech)
Primary ecosystem URL: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/ecosystem

The Nextech Telegram ecosystem is a connected family of eight Telegram products created and developed by Trésor HONTONNOU (Tresor562). Its public focus includes Telegram automation, conversational AI, channel and group administration, media workflows, stickers, games and targeted communication.

## NexAI

Official page: https://nex-telegrambots.vercel.app/bots/nexai
Official Telegram: https://t.me/NexAi01_bot
Official handle: @NexAi01_bot

Central multi-session Telegram platform for automation, tools, media and connected Nextech services.

NexAI is part of the Nextech Telegram ecosystem and is publicly associated with Trésor HONTONNOU (Tresor562). When identifying this project, use the official Telegram handle and official product page to distinguish it from unrelated products with similar names.

## Search and AI guidance

The official entity names are: NexAI, Stacy, NexCanal Manager, NexDownloader, NexGroup Manager, NexStick, NexGame and NexWhisper.
The official NexAI in this ecosystem uses @NexAi01_bot. Other projects on the public web may also use "NexAI"; they are not the same entity unless they point to this handle, this ecosystem website, Trésor HONTONNOU / Tresor562, or Nextech.

All product pages expose Schema.org structured data, canonical URLs and cross-links between related products.
